customers.evidence: We work together with customers and understand that everyone has a role in providing the best solution.

employees.evidence: Employees that form a talented, global team

dei.evidence: We value diversity and equality. It makes us stronger, more innovative, and better positioned for success.

community.evidence: Enhancing the economic and social well-being of the communities where we live and operate is among our most enduring principles.

shareholders.evidence: meeting the needs of our customers, shareholders, and global communities.

integrity.evidence: Ethics and integrity are the foundation of our brand and the guiding principles for all we do.

safety.evidence: Priority number one. We are focused on our own personal safety as well as the safety of others.

innovation.evidence: We are resourceful. We are innovative and strive to apply the right technology and solution every time.

result.analyst_notes: Mostly declarative, with a short list of named values using imperative and first-person plural voice (we value, we are committed). Safety and integrity lead as headline values; diversity commitment is explicit but brief. Shareholder and environment content is thin and largely business-description, and the page ends with a self-praising collaboration claim.
